TC-22/S09.title: Counts and length, app half: 0 / 1 / 12 open tasks handled in both contexts; a Hospital pre-round longer than 1,200 characters loses the tasks dictated after it
TC-22/S09.detail: Local stack on main 43c38a4f; every model call the page makes is answered in the page by ext-support.ts (an ai/* call it is not told about is failed, never forwarded) and the tripwire showed no model call. The task extractor is a rule-based stand-in that can only find what the app sends it (args.content / args.openTasks), so the app's own request, cut, merge and storage are what is judged, not the model. Spec ext-tc22-s09-s10-length.spec.ts. C0/C1/C12 in both contexts (16/16 judged per context): every open task is sent (0, 1, 12), the answered ones close, the other ten stay open, nothing added or duplicated, the header counts the open tasks. L1 fails, 1/3 (deterministic): a 1,266-character pre-round note whose three tasks start at character 1,214 — the harvest request carries only the first 1,200 characters (usePreRoundProcess.ts: input.trim().substring(0, 1200)), so no extractor can see the tasks; after Save Note the list shows 0 pending tasks. The model half of C0/C1/C12 is the dev entry.
TC-22/S09.productIssue: Hospital: in a pre-round note longer than 1,200 characters, follow-ups dictated at the end ('Follow up BMP. PT eval. Recheck weight in two weeks.') never become tasks — the app sends only the first 1,200 characters to the task harvest; nothing tells the physician.
